Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the release of certain laboratory records.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to laboratory records; and adding a new section tochapter 43.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Requests for records to the state toxicology laboratory for recordsrelated to testing performed on deceased individuals in deathinvestigations and on living suspects in impaired driving cases must bemade to the agency that submitted the material for analysis.
